title: Four Stress Vectors of the Travel Domain in Mechanism Testing

columns.label: Analytical Challenge for Collective Formation
columns.description: Why standard aggregation fails under this condition

cells.market: 1. Severe Constraint Variance (Exact dates, visas, child seats, mobility)
cells.person: Preferences cannot be averaged; single constraint failure invalidates the position

cells.market: 2. Temporal Perishability (Fixed departure dates, inventory expiration)
cells.person: Waiting for group consensus creates severe opportunity cost vs individual booking
Supplier rejection on one leg collapses the entire multi-participant itinerary

cells.market: 4. Catastrophic Dissolution Impact (Stranded families, lost vacations)
cells.person: Zero tolerance for loose commitment; requires bulletproof dissolution floors

caption: Why the travel domain functions as the ultimate proving ground for collective market formation.
scopeLimits: Conceptual analysis. GOLIAF is a research environment, not a commercial travel platform.
limitations: Theoretical stress vectors; empirical metrics in development.

accessibility.textEquivalent: Table mapping 4 stress vectors of travel (Constraint Variance, Temporal Perishability, Multi-Leg Interdependency, Catastrophic Dissolution Impact) against their analytical challenge.
